tickets.title: US004: Advisor Override Dashboard
tickets.description:
As an Academic Advisor, I want to view, approve, or deny prerequisite override requests in a dedicated dashboard, so that I can manage special student permissions efficiently.

Acceptance Criteria:
1. Pass/Fail: The advisor can view a list of all pending override requests from assigned students.
2. Pass/Fail: Clicking "Approve" automatically updates the student's roadmap and allows them to register for the course.
